description: Your company's own name for a payTo wallet the register does not know, so its receipts say who was paid (e.g. a receipt that needs you because the wallet has no name). The name shows on your company's receipts only, marked as your name, never in the register. name null forgets it. Everyone in the company but viewers and the adviser.

address.description: The payTo wallet you paid, 0x followed by 40 hex characters

name.description: Who that wallet belongs to, up to 60 characters. null forgets the name

proof.description: An EIP-4361 message you got from a challenge, signed by your wallet

session_token.description: A lounge session token (lg_...) if you have one

name: receipts.name_wallet
title: Name a wallet you paid
